cards.hint: Cards are per patient. Enter a patient ID, or open them from an application review.

queue.description: The cross-patient queue. Opening an application claims it for review.
queue.searchNotFound: No application found with that number.

empty.title: Nothing here
empty.forAll: No applications have been submitted yet.

error.title: Couldn't load the queue
error.description: Something went wrong while fetching the applications.

error.title: Couldn't open this application
error.notFound: This application doesn't exist — it may have been removed.
error.description: Something went wrong while fetching the review details.

approve.label: Approve
approve.title: Approve this application?
approve.description: Cards are issued automatically for the applicant and their dependents. This cannot be undone.

reject.label: Reject
reject.title: Reject this application?
reject.description: The citizen sees your reason and can start over with a new application.

request-documents.label: Request documents
request-documents.title: Send back for documents?
request-documents.description: The application returns to the citizen. They upload the missing documents, then it comes back to review.

issue.label: Issue cards
issue.title: Issue cards for this application?
issue.description: Use this only if approval did not create cards. The application must stay Approved.
issue.confirm: Creates a card for the applicant and each dependent on this application. Does nothing if cards already exist.

fields.citizenReasonPlaceholder: Explain what you decided and why…
fields.citizenReasonHint: Shown on the citizen's tracking page.

actions.requestedDocuments: Sent back to the citizen for documents.

errors.reasonRequired: A reason shown to the citizen is required for this decision.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.conflict: This application changed — another reviewer may have acted first. Refreshing.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

cards.title: Card management
cards.description: The patient's full card history, including dependents' cards. Lifecycle actions apply per card.

suspend.title: Suspend this card?
suspend.description: The card stops verifying temporarily. It can be reactivated later.

revoke.title: Revoke this card?
revoke.description: Permanent — this cannot be undone. Only revoke for fraud or eligibility loss.

renew.title: Renew this card?
renew.description: Issues a fresh successor card with a new validity period.

replace.title: Replace this card
replace.description: Issues a successor card; expiry carries forward from this one when still valid.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this card?
reactivate.description: Returns a suspended card to active status.

rotate-token.title: Rotate the card token?
rotate-token.description: The embedded QR/NFC secret changes; status and validity stay the same.

dialogs.reasonHint: Recorded in the card's audit trail.

toasts.issued: {count, plural, one {# card issued.} other {# cards issued.}}

snapshot.title: Patient snapshot
snapshot.description: Current card, insurance status, and this patient's applications.

errors.none: No cards have been issued for this patient yet.
errors.alreadyIssued: Cards already exist for this application, or it is not Approved.
errors.reasonInvalid: A reason of 1–1000 characters is required.

table.title: Patient cards
table.description: All patients with applications. Click a patient to manage their card lifecycle.
table.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or national ID…

categories.title: Insurance categories
categories.description: The reference data the citizen wizard reads. Edits apply without a deploy.

general.description: Identity fields. The code is fixed after creation.
general.codeImmutable: The code identifies the category and cannot be changed.

rule.description: Age range, marital-status restriction, guardian and dependent rules.
rule.maritalHint: Leave all unselected for no restriction.

requirements.description: Granular requirement rows — add, update, or remove one at a time.
requirements.deleteDescription: The citizen wizard stops asking for this document immediately.

preview.description: What the citizen sees on the apply page.

replace.title: Replace required types
replace.description: Full replace: every selected type stays required; omitted types are dropped. Use granular rows below for labels and help text.

create.title: New category
create.description: Creates a category; add its requirements and rule next.

errors.name: Name must be 1–100 characters.

errors.age: Ages must be non-negative whole numbers.
errors.ageRange: Minimum age is above maximum age.
errors.url: Sample URL must be a valid http(s) link.
errors.validation: Check the form — some values are invalid.
errors.conflict: The category changed on the server — refreshing.
